actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.local_scraper.description: Extract content from HTML content using AI by providing a natural language prompt.
actions.local_scraper.props.output_schem: Optional schema to structure the output data.
Describe what information you want to extract in natural language.
actions.markdownify.description: Convert any webpage into clean, readable Markdown format.
actions.markdownify.props.website_url.de: The webpage URL to convert to Markdown
actions.scrapegrapghai_create_monitor.de: Schedules a recurring fetch of a page with change detection.
actions.scrapegrapghai_create_monitor.pr: Optional fetch options object: mode ("auto" default, "fast" or "js"), stealth (true for residential proxy, +5 credits), headers (object), cookies (object), scrolls (0-100), wait (ms after load, 0-30000), timeout (ms, 1000-60000), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code), e.g. {"mode":"js","wait":2000}.

Output formats to capture for the page: markdown, html, links, images, summary (AI summary), json (AI extraction, needs JSON Prompt), branding (colors, fonts, logos) or screenshot (pre-signed image URL valid for 1 hour).
5-field cron expression in UTC for how often to fetch, e.g. "*/30 * * * *" (every 30 minutes) or "0 9 * * 1" (Mondays 09:00).
Natural-language description of the data to extract. Required when the json format is selected; ignored otherwise.
Optional JSON Schema object the json output must match, e.g. {"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"}}}. Only used with the json format.
Pre-processing for the markdown and html formats: normal (full page), reader (main article only) or prune (strip boilerplate). Defaults to normal.
Human-readable monitor name, e.g. "Pricing page watch".
Public page URL to watch, including the scheme.
Optional URL that receives a POST with the captured payload on every tick.
actions.scrapegrapghai_delete_crawl.desc: Permanently deletes a crawl job and its stored pages.
actions.scrapegrapghai_delete_crawl.prop: Crawl job UUID, returned as `id` by Start Crawl.
actions.scrapegrapghai_delete_monitor.de: Permanently deletes a monitor and its run history.
actions.scrapegrapghai_delete_monitor.pr: Monitor UUID, returned as `cronId` by Create Monitor or List Monitors.
actions.scrapegrapghai_extract_data.desc: Extracts structured data from a URL, HTML or markdown using a natural-language prompt.
actions.scrapegrapghai_extract_data.prop: Optional fetch options object: mode ("auto" default, "fast" or "js"), stealth (true for residential proxy, +5 credits), headers (object), cookies (object), scrolls (0-100), wait (ms after load, 0-30000), timeout (ms, 1000-60000), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code), e.g. {"mode":"js","wait":2000}.
Raw HTML to extract from (max 2 MB). Provide exactly one of URL, HTML or Markdown.
Markdown text to extract from (max 2 MB). Provide exactly one of URL, HTML or Markdown.
Pre-processing of the source: normal, reader (main article only) or prune (strip boilerplate). Defaults to normal.
Natural-language description of what to extract, e.g. "the product name and price".
Optional JSON Schema object the output must match.
Public page URL to fetch and extract from. Provide exactly one of URL, HTML or Markdown.
actions.scrapegrapghai_get_crawl.descrip: Gets the status and progress of a crawl job.
actions.scrapegrapghai_get_crawl.props.c: Crawl job UUID, returned as `id` by Start Crawl.
actions.scrapegrapghai_get_credits.descr: Gets the remaining credit balance, plan and job quotas.
actions.scrapegrapghai_get_history_entry: Gets one past request and its full result by ID.
UUID of the request: `id` from Scrape Page, Extract Data or Search the Web, `scrapeRefId` from Get Crawl, or a run `id` from List Monitor Activity.
actions.scrapegrapghai_get_monitor.props: Monitor UUID, returned as `cronId` by Create Monitor or List Monitors.
Lists the pages of a crawl job with their scraped content.
Crawl job UUID, returned as `id` by Start Crawl.
Zero-based page index to start from, from `pagination.nextCursor`. Defaults to 0.
actions.scrapegrapghai_list_history.desc: Lists past API requests, newest first.
actions.scrapegrapghai_list_history.prop: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.
Only return requests from this service. Defaults to all.
Only return requests whose session ID contains this text (case-insensitive).
actions.scrapegrapghai_list_monitor_acti: Lists a monitor's recent runs with change flags.
The `nextCursor` timestamp from the previous call, to fetch older runs.
Monitor UUID, returned as `cronId` by Create Monitor or List Monitors.
actions.scrapegrapghai_list_monitors.des: Lists all monitors on the account.
actions.scrapegrapghai_pause_monitor.des: Pauses a monitor so it stops running.
actions.scrapegrapghai_pause_monitor.pro: Monitor UUID, returned as `cronId` by Create Monitor or List Monitors.
actions.scrapegrapghai_resume_crawl.prop: Crawl job UUID, returned as `id` by Start Crawl.
actions.scrapegrapghai_resume_monitor.pr: Monitor UUID, returned as `cronId` by Create Monitor or List Monitors.
actions.scrapegrapghai_scrape_page.descr: Fetches a URL and returns its content in one or more formats.
actions.scrapegrapghai_scrape_page.props: Optional fetch options object: mode ("auto" default, "fast" or "js"), stealth (true for residential proxy, +5 credits), headers (object), cookies (object), scrolls (0-100), wait (ms after load, 0-30000), timeout (ms, 1000-60000), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code), e.g. {"mode":"js","wait":2000}.

Output formats to capture for the page: markdown, html, links, images, summary (AI summary), json (AI extraction, needs JSON Prompt), branding (colors, fonts, logos) or screenshot (pre-signed image URL valid for 1 hour).
Natural-language description of the data to extract. Required when the json format is selected; ignored otherwise.
Optional JSON Schema object the json output must match, e.g. {"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"}}}. Only used with the json format.
Pre-processing for the markdown and html formats: normal (full page), reader (main article only) or prune (strip boilerplate). Defaults to normal.
Public page URL including the scheme, e.g. "https://example.com/pricing". Private and internal addresses are rejected.
actions.scrapegrapghai_search_web.descri: Runs a web search and returns the top results with their page content.
Optional fetch options object: mode ("auto" default, "fast" or "js"), stealth (true for residential proxy, +5 credits), headers (object), cookies (object), scrolls (0-100), wait (ms after load, 0-30000), timeout (ms, 1000-60000), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code), e.g. {"mode":"js","wait":2000}.
Format of each result's inline content. Defaults to markdown.
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for localized results, e.g. "us" or "it".
How many results to fetch, 1-20. Defaults to 3.
Optional extraction prompt run across all fetched results; the answer is returned under `json`.
Optional JSON Schema object for the extraction output. Requires Prompt.
Only return results published within this window. Defaults to any time.
actions.scrapegrapghai_start_crawl.descr: Starts an asynchronous multi-page crawl and returns its job ID.
actions.scrapegrapghai_start_crawl.props: Follow links to other domains. Defaults to false.
Glob URL patterns to skip, e.g. ["/admin/*"].

Optional fetch options object: mode ("auto" default, "fast" or "js"), stealth (true for residential proxy, +5 credits), headers (object), cookies (object), scrolls (0-100), wait (ms after load, 0-30000), timeout (ms, 1000-60000), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code), e.g. {"mode":"js","wait":2000}.

Glob URL patterns to include, e.g. ["/blog/*"].
Natural-language description of the data to extract. Required when the json format is selected; ignored otherwise.
Optional JSON Schema object the json output must match, e.g. {"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"}}}. Only used with the json format.
How many levels of links to follow from the starting URL.
Cap on links followed from each page.
Maximum number of pages to crawl.
Pre-processing for the markdown and html formats: normal (full page), reader (main article only) or prune (strip boilerplate). Defaults to normal.
Starting URL of the crawl, including the scheme.
Crawl job UUID, returned as `id` by Start Crawl.

auth.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your ScrapeGraphAI API Key:

1. Visit [ScrapeGraphAI](https://scrapegraphai.com) and create an account.
2. Log in and navigate to your dashboard.
3. Locate and copy your API key from the dashboard.
